purpose: Complete continuous desktop and phone research-drawer scenes; open and closed state pairs.

open.desktop: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a complete background illustration for a pixel-art adventure game object scene. Image 1 is a STYLE reference: its warm intimate room, dark green wood, amber lantern light, blocky pixels and cream paper. Image 2 is an OBJECT reference for the old research drawer: three folders, brass pull handle, rolled map, compass, notebook, one tiny colorful toy brick. Neither reference is an edit target; draw one NEW complete scene. CRITICAL STYLE: fixed coarse logical pixel grid about 128x85 for landscape or 85x128 portrait, strongly visible square pixel clusters, hard stepped edges, limited palette, NO smooth gradients, no fine paper grain, no painterly texture. It must feel like a closeup inside the same room. No text, words, labels, letters, numbers, captions, UI border or watermark. The paper must be calm solid cream with very simple large-block edge shading, left blank for HTML text. LANDSCAPE output 1536x1024, aspect ratio 3:2. A single continuous lantern-lit desk scene, NOT a split panel or collage. On the left 55% of the composition is a small vintage dark-green wooden desk with an OPEN drawer, viewed slightly from above. The drawer takes x=5% to55%, y=30% to88%; three distinct upright cream file folders sit side by side across the left half of its interior, then a rolled map, compass and a tiny red-yellow-blue toy brick. The drawer front has a clear brass cup handle at x=30%,y=83%. On the right, a large upright clipboard or propped writing board rests naturally on the SAME desk, with blank cream paper covering x=61% to94%, y=15% to84%. Its paper surface must be rectangular, large, and nearly front-facing for real text. Both sides share one continuous perspective, lighting, wooden desk, greenery and background. Include a lantern at upper left and a hint of the dark window behind; keep foliage and all decoration off the middle of the paper. The paper and drawer are rendered together in one cohesive painting, never composited from separate crops.

closed.desktop: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an approved complete pixel-art desk scene. Make the CLOSED-DRAWER state of this exact same scene. Change ONLY the open drawer: push it shut into the desk, hiding every folder, map, compass, notebook and toy brick inside it, and show a believable continuous dark-green wooden drawer front with its brass cup pull handle. Preserve the drawer's object identity, wood color, brass handle style, coarse hard pixel clusters and warm lantern lighting. CRITICAL INVARIANTS: Keep the camera, canvas size, framing, clipboard, blank cream paper, paper corners and all background objects, vines, lamp, window, books and table exactly where they are. Do not move, shrink, crop, reframe, relight, recolor, redraw or add any detail to the blank writing paper. It must swap in place with the source open image. No text, no UI, no lettering, no watermarks. No compositing seam, no fake separate rectangular overlay, no smooth gradients or fine-grain texture. Produce one complete coherent illustration of the same desk with its drawer CLOSED. LANDSCAPE 1536x1024. The closed drawer stays on the left side of the clipboard. The right-side paper must remain identical in shape and pixel placement. Keep the brass handle prominent in the center of the drawer front; keep its horizontal center at the existing x=30% location.
